name: Official Joke API
tagline: Free no-auth setup/punchline jokes for demos and teaching
description: A simple public HTTP API serving random and typed jokes in a setup/punchline JSON format. No authentication is required. It is commonly used for demos, teaching REST, and light novelty features.

auth.details: No authentication required; all endpoints are public and unauthenticated.

example.response_snippet: {"id":1,"type":"general","setup":"What did the fish say when it hit the wall?","punchline":"Dam."}

use_cases: list jokes by type such as programming or general
get ten random jokes for a demo UI
look up a joke by numeric id
teach basic HTTP GET and JSON parsing
